title: narcissus calcicola subsp. onubensis
intro: Narcissus calcicola subsp. onubensis, commonly known as Spanish bluebells or Onubense narcissus, is a subspecies of the Narcissus calcicola plant, native to the southwestern Iberian Peninsula. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus calcicola subsp. onubensis include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
